messages:
anna: Need a quick callout: dense Create Model form — should required be an asterisk or the word 'Required'? Feedback before I update Figma. mike: Word 'Required' pls. Asterisk gets missed and isn't great for localization. Use a lighter token so it doesn't scream. lexi: Accessibility: if we persist an asterisk visually, make sure the accessible label contains 'required'. Prefer visible text for clarity. raj: For inline errors — avoid layout shift. Reserve helper space under inputs and swap copy/color rather than insert new DOM height. mike: Example CSS: `.input-helper { min-height: 1.25rem; }` Keeps page stable when errors appear. anna: Cross-field errors (e.g., retention < minRetention) — top-of-step summary or inline? lexi: Top summary for cross-field with focusable links into fields. Each link moves focus and announces context. raj: Also: typed-confirm for deletes — only for org-level destructive actions. Mobile is painful otherwise. For resource-level deletes use checkbox + clear CTA. mike: Agreed. And if we use typed-confirm, ensure mismatch errors are announced with `role=\"alert\"` and not just a red placeholder. lexi: Sample snippet for announce: ```html
Text doesn't match
``` anna: Quick sprint decision draft: 1) visible 'Required' text tokenized for i18n 2) inline errors with reserved helper space 3) top summary for cross-field with focus links 4) typed-confirm only for org-scope deletions 5) add aria-invalid/aria-describedby + role=alert examples in docs. dev-bot: Created issue https://redwood.internals/issue/5021 — "forms: dense label + validation + scoped confirm patterns" :white_check_mark: anna: Thanks — i'll update Figma and send PR for the component patch. :thumbsup:
